name: Hellenic Civil Aviation Authority
notes: Name and role confirmed on hcaa.gov.gr/en (title 'HELLENIC CIVIL AVIATION AUTHORITY - HCAA'; the site covers regulation, air-navigation and airport content under one body). Web search found Greek press (news.gtp.gr, Oct 2025) describing the 2025 reform that makes the CAA a public-law entity that continues as ANSP and airport manager; older documents (EUROCONTROL LSSIP 2022) list a separate HASP. No separate ANSP site or entity was identified on the official page, so both types are kept on this single folder (README-derived role not changed). The logo is an SVG served by hcaa.gov.gr in its site header and footer (tier 2, website-served). No logo terms located, so redistribution rights are not confirmed.

gaps.reason: hcaa.gov.gr serves only one full-colour SVG (header and footer); no brand page or press kit located on the site

contact.notes: Contact page https://hcaa.gov.gr/en/epikoinonia/online-forms/contact-us exists; no logo-use contact published (footer email is obfuscated and general).
